domains.label: Platform
domains.purpose: Run by Sakalya: plans, billing clinics, feature rollout, support, platform analytics. Console only.

domains.label: Identity
domains.purpose: People who sign in, their sessions and devices. One user can belong to many clinics.

domains.label: Clinic setup
domains.purpose: The clinic itself: branches, domains, rooms, modules, roles, staff memberships, numbering.

domains.label: Patients and doctors
domains.purpose: Each clinic's own patient records, identifiers, families, referral sources and practitioners.

domains.label: Scheduling
domains.purpose: Appointments, their history, and the walk-in token queue.

domains.label: Clinical
domains.purpose: Visits, notes, vitals, diagnoses, prescriptions, procedures, treatment plans, files and specialty data.

domains.label: Clinic operations
domains.purpose: Lab work, inventory and stock, equipment maintenance, payroll and consultant fees.

domains.label: Money
domains.purpose: Price list, bills, payments, refunds, expenses and daily cash closing.

domains.label: Notifications
domains.purpose: Templates, rules, consent, recalls, campaigns, promo codes, the outbox and every message sent.

domains.label: Websites
domains.purpose: Generated clinic websites, their versions, booking requests and traffic.

domains.label: Trust and audit
domains.purpose: Patient consents, who viewed what, every change, and data-rights requests.

domains.label: Onboarding
domains.purpose: First-login progress and data imports from old software.

tables.name: plans
tables.purpose: Subscription plans clinics can buy (Solo, Clinic, Pro, Enterprise).

tables.name: features
tables.purpose: Every feature that a plan can include or limit.

tables.name: plan_features
tables.purpose: What each plan includes, and its limits.
tables.notes: Primary key (plan_id, feature_id).

tables.name: subscriptions
tables.purpose: Which plan a clinic is on and whether it is paid up.

tables.name: saas_invoices
tables.purpose: Sakalya's own GST invoices to clinics for the subscription.

tables.name: entitlement_overrides
tables.purpose: Per-clinic exceptions to the plan: promos, grandfathering, custom deals.

tables.name: usage_counters
tables.purpose: How much of each limited feature a clinic used this month.
tables.notes: Primary key (org_id, feature_id, period). Incremented by the API and worker.

tables.name: feature_flags
tables.purpose: Switches that release a feature gradually, separate from plans.

tables.name: flag_rules
tables.purpose: Who a flag is on for: named clinics, a percentage, a plan, a platform or app version.

tables.name: platform_users
tables.purpose: Sakalya staff who can use the console, and their role.

tables.name: support_grants
tables.purpose: Time-limited permission a clinic gives Sakalya support to look inside its data.

tables.name: announcements
tables.purpose: Release notes and notices shown inside the clinic apps.

tables.name: org_daily_stats
tables.purpose: Per-clinic daily counts for the console. Counts only, never patient data.
tables.notes: Primary key (org_id, day). Written nightly, copied to BigQuery.

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Anyone who signs in: staff, doctors, patients, Sakalya staff.

tables.name: sessions
tables.purpose: Signed-in sessions, so a stolen phone or idle PC can be signed out.

tables.name: devices
tables.purpose: Phones and browsers a user signs in from, with push tokens.

tables.name: organizations
tables.purpose: A clinic business, the tenant. Everything clinic-owned points here.

tables.name: branches
tables.purpose: Locations of a clinic. Single-location clinics have one.

tables.name: org_domains
tables.purpose: Host names that resolve to a clinic: its portal and its website.
tables.notes: Read on every request to resolve the tenant; cached in memory.

tables.name: slug_history
tables.purpose: Old slugs, so renamed clinics, doctors and pages keep redirecting.

tables.name: rooms
tables.purpose: Chairs, rooms and labs that appointments can be booked into.

tables.name: org_modules
tables.purpose: Specialty modules switched on for a clinic, with their settings.

cols.name: settings
cols.note: e.g. tooth numbering FDI or Universal

tables.name: org_settings
tables.purpose: One row per clinic: branding, bill and prescription settings, defaults.

tables.name: assets
tables.purpose: Non-medical files: logos, signatures, generated PDFs, website images.
tables.notes: Stored in a different bucket from patient attachments.

tables.name: roles
tables.purpose: Named bundles of permissions. Seeded from templates; owners can add their own.

cols.name: key
cols.note: owner, doctor, consultant, finance, front_desk, assistant, or custom

tables.name: role_permissions
tables.purpose: What a role may do: module.action plus a scope.
tables.notes: Primary key (org_id, role_id, permission).

tables.name: memberships
tables.purpose: A user's place in a clinic: role, branches, status. The link between users and clinics.

tables.name: invitations
tables.purpose: Pending invites to join a clinic.

tables.name: number_sequences
tables.purpose: Counters behind readable numbers: SC-1042, V-2026-0318, SC/26-27/000318.
tables.notes: Primary key (org_id, kind, period). Incremented with UPDATE ... RETURNING inside the same transaction.

cols.name: period
cols.note: financial year such as 26-27, or empty

tables.name: patients
tables.purpose: A clinic's own record of a patient. Two clinics never share this row.
tables.notes: Name search uses a pg_trgm index. Duplicate warning on the same phone number.

cols.name: number
cols.note: SC-1042, unique per clinic, used in URLs

cols.name: age_estimate_years
cols.note: when the date of birth is unknown

tables.name: patient_identifiers
tables.purpose: Extra IDs for a patient: custom file number, smart card, ABHA, legacy import.
tables.notes: Unique (org_id, kind, value).

tables.name: family_links
tables.purpose: Relationships between patients in the same clinic: parent, child, spouse, guardian.

cols.name: can_manage
cols.note: guardian may act for this patient

tables.name: referral_sources
tables.purpose: Where patients come from, for the finance and marketing filters.

cols.name: kind
cols.note: patient, doctor, online, walk_in, camp, insurance, other

tables.name: medical_history_items
tables.purpose: History captured at registration: conditions, surgeries, habits, family history.

tables.name: patient_links
tables.purpose: Phase 3: connects a patient's own Arogyam account to their record at each clinic.
tables.notes: This is the single-umbrella view: one person, many clinic records, joined only by verified links.

tables.name: practitioners
tables.purpose: Doctors who see patients at the clinic, with registration and fees.

tables.name: working_hours
tables.purpose: Weekly hours per clinic or doctor. Split shifts are two rows.

tables.name: leave_blocks
tables.purpose: Time a doctor or branch is unavailable.

tables.name: appointments
tables.purpose: A booked slot with a doctor, optionally in a room or chair.
tables.notes: An exclusion constraint on (org_id, practitioner_id, time range) stops double booking.

cols.name: status
cols.note: scheduled, confirmed, arrived, in_progress, completed, cancelled, no_show

tables.name: appointment_events
tables.purpose: Every status change of an appointment, for history and no-show reports.

tables.name: queue_tokens
tables.purpose: Walk-in tokens shown on the waiting-room screen.
tables.notes: Unique (org_id, branch_id, day, token_number).

tables.name: encounters
tables.purpose: One visit: everything clinical from that day hangs off it.

tables.name: clinical_notes
tables.purpose: Doctor and intake notes. Signed notes never change.
tables.notes: Reading a note writes access_log. Corrections go in note_addenda.

tables.name: note_addenda
tables.purpose: Corrections and additions to a signed note, with their own author and time.

tables.name: observations
tables.purpose: Measurements: BP, pulse, temperature, SpO2, weight, height, sugar.

cols.name: kind
cols.note: bp_systolic, bp_diastolic, pulse, temperature, spo2, weight, height, blood_sugar ...

tables.name: conditions
tables.purpose: Diagnoses, coded where possible.

tables.name: allergies
tables.purpose: Allergies, shown as a warning banner on the patient.

tables.name: drug_catalog
tables.purpose: Shared list of medicines (brand, generic, strength) for quick prescribing.

tables.name: prescriptions
tables.purpose: A prescription issued in a visit, printed or sent as a PDF.

tables.name: prescription_items
tables.purpose: One medicine on a prescription.

tables.name: procedures
tables.purpose: Treatment actually done (or planned for today), linked to the price list.
tables.notes: Marking done deducts stock via procedure_materials and can create a lab_order.

cols.name: site
cols.note: specialty location, e.g. tooth 36, surfaces O and D

tables.name: treatment_plans
tables.purpose: A proposed course of treatment with a cost estimate, accepted or declined by the patient.

tables.name: treatment_plan_items
tables.purpose: Steps of a treatment plan, in phases.

tables.name: attachments
tables.purpose: Patient files: photos, X-rays, reports, documents, audio, signed consent.
tables.notes: Served only through short-lived signed URLs after a permission check.

cols.name: kind
cols.note: photo, xray, report, document, audio, consent

tables.name: voice_notes
tables.purpose: A recorded note, its transcription status and the draft it produced.

tables.name: specialty_records
tables.purpose: Specialty-specific data as versioned JSON: tooth chart, pregnancy, growth.
tables.notes: New rows supersede old ones, so the chart's history is kept.

cols.name: data
cols.note: validated against the module schema on write

tables.name: document_templates
tables.purpose: Consent forms, certificates and letter templates a clinic uses.

tables.name: consent_forms
tables.purpose: A signed procedure consent.

tables.name: lab_vendors
tables.purpose: Outside labs: dental labs for crowns, pathology, radiology.

tables.name: lab_orders
tables.purpose: Work sent to a lab, its due date and status.

tables.name: lab_payments
tables.purpose: Money paid to labs.

tables.name: suppliers
tables.purpose: Where materials are bought.

tables.name: inventory_items
tables.purpose: Materials and medicines the clinic stocks.

tables.name: stock_batches
tables.purpose: Received stock by batch, with expiry and cost.

tables.name: stock_movements
tables.purpose: Every change in stock: purchase, use, adjustment, expiry. Stock history comes from here.

tables.name: procedure_materials
tables.purpose: Materials a treatment uses, so stock deducts itself.

tables.name: equipment
tables.purpose: Chairs, autoclaves, X-ray units and their service schedule.

tables.name: maintenance_logs
tables.purpose: Services and repairs done on equipment, and when the next is due.

tables.name: salary_structures
tables.purpose: A staff member's monthly salary from a date.

tables.name: payroll_entries
tables.purpose: Salary paid for a month, with deductions and advances recovered.

tables.name: staff_advances
tables.purpose: Salary advances given to staff and how much is recovered.

tables.name: consultant_fee_rules
tables.purpose: How a visiting consultant is paid: a percentage or fixed amount per treatment.

tables.name: consultant_payouts
tables.purpose: Payments made to consultants for a period.

tables.name: price_items
tables.purpose: The clinic's price list. Seeded from the specialty, then edited.

tables.name: invoices
tables.purpose: A bill to a patient. Totals are stored; balance is derived.

tables.name: invoice_items
tables.purpose: Lines on a bill, each optionally tied to a procedure and doctor.

tables.name: payments
tables.purpose: Money received from a patient, by any method.

cols.name: method
cols.note: cash, upi, card, bank_transfer, cheque, razorpay, insurance

tables.name: payment_allocations
tables.purpose: Which bills a payment pays, so advances and partial payments work.

tables.name: refunds
tables.purpose: Money returned to a patient.

tables.name: expense_categories
tables.purpose: Rent, electricity, salaries, consumables and so on.

tables.name: expenses
tables.purpose: Money the clinic spends.

tables.name: daily_closings
tables.purpose: End-of-day cash count against what the system expects.

tables.name: message_templates
tables.purpose: Message text per channel and language. Clinic rows override platform defaults.
tables.notes: org_id is null for platform defaults; this table allows that.

tables.name: notification_rules
tables.purpose: When to message: on an event, before an appointment, on birthdays, on recalls.

tables.name: contact_preferences
tables.purpose: Per patient and channel: may we message them, and was promotional consent given?
tables.notes: Primary key (org_id, patient_id, channel).

tables.name: recalls
tables.purpose: Follow-ups that are due: cleaning in six months, BP review, vaccine.

tables.name: audiences
tables.purpose: Saved patient filters for campaigns: age, sex, treatment, doctor, fees, history.

tables.name: campaigns
tables.purpose: A one-off or scheduled send to an audience: health tips, offers.

tables.name: promo_codes
tables.purpose: Discount codes a clinic can share.

tables.name: promo_redemptions
tables.purpose: Each use of a promo code on a bill.

tables.name: outbox_events
tables.purpose: Events written in the same transaction as the change, for the worker to act on.
tables.notes: Guarantees a message is never lost or sent for a change that rolled back.

tables.name: messages
tables.purpose: Every message scheduled or sent, with its outcome and cost.

cols.name: status
cols.note: scheduled, queued, sent, delivered, read, failed, skipped

tables.name: message_events
tables.purpose: Delivery receipts from providers: sent, delivered, read, failed.

tables.name: notifications
tables.purpose: The in-app notification feed for staff.

tables.name: sites
tables.purpose: A clinic's generated website: template family, repository and live version.

tables.name: site_versions
tables.purpose: Each publish of a site, so any version can be restored.

tables.name: booking_requests
tables.purpose: Booking requests from the website, before they become appointments.

tables.name: site_daily_stats
tables.purpose: Website visits and bookings per day, for the clinic and the console.
tables.notes: Primary key (org_id, day). Imported from Cloudflare Web Analytics.

tables.name: consents
tables.purpose: Phase 3: a patient lets one clinic see records from another, for a purpose and time.

tables.name: access_log
tables.purpose: Who opened which patient record, when. Patients can see this.
tables.notes: Append-only: the app role can insert but never update or delete.

tables.name: audit_events
tables.purpose: Every insert, update and delete, written by triggers.
tables.notes: Append-only. org_id may be null for platform tables.

tables.name: data_requests
tables.purpose: Patients' DPDP requests: export, correction, erasure.

tables.name: onboarding_progress
tables.purpose: Where a new clinic is in the first-login wizard, and its answers.
tables.notes: One row per clinic.

tables.name: imports
tables.purpose: A data import from Excel or old software.

tables.name: import_rows
tables.purpose: Each row of an import with its result, so failures can be fixed and retried.

steps.what: Clinic created on a trial plan with its subdomain.
Owner accepts the invite and becomes a member with the owner role.
Specialty, branding, prices and hours set up from defaults.
Site generated from answers, repository created, built and deployed.
Patients brought in from the old software, keeping file numbers.
New patient registered as SC-1042, or found by name, phone or ID.
Appointment marked arrived; token shown on the waiting screen.
Visit opened; vitals and intake note recorded.
Dictates a note, adds an X-ray, updates the tooth chart; every view is logged.
Root canal done on tooth 36: stock deducted, crown sent to the lab, prescription issued.
Bill SC/26-27/000318 issued and paid by UPI.
Receipt sent on WhatsApp, a follow-up recall created, all changes audited.
Clinic has reminder, birthday and recall rules switched on.
Due messages created with a dedupe key, e.g. reminder:appt:24h.
Consent, quiet hours and quota checked; message sent or skipped with a reason.
Delivery and read receipts recorded; cost metered per clinic.
Collections by doctor, treatment, referral source and payment method.
Spending by category, lab, staff and consultant.
A ledger view joins both sides; exported to Excel by the worker.
smilecatchers.arogyam.app resolves to the clinic.
JWT verified, session still active.
User is an active member whose role allows patients.read.
Feature is in the plan and released to this clinic.
Row-level security limits every query to this clinic.

journeys.title: Phase 3: a patient sees all their clinics

steps.what: Patient signs in with their phone and verifies records at each clinic.
Patient lets their new cardiologist see their dental and GP records.
Reads the shared records; the patient sees who looked.
